quest.title: Forbidding Doors of Melancholy
quest.description: You've taken the elevator up. Now, the assembly hall is right in front of you...

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: The bridge to the assembly hall is right over there. But where is Furiosa? I usually see her around here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Is this "Furiosa" someone really important, Nastya? Paimon's heard you mention her quite a few times now.

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Of course! She's my idol! Or should I say, she's still my number-one idol right now, and you two are at number two for now.

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: You should have a match-up with her when you have the time! Maybe the rankings will change then!

choices.text: A chance to shake up the leaderboard has appeared!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Aw, yeah! {NICKNAME} is a super good fighter, you know!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But Paimon gets it now: Nastya likes people who are good at fighting. The stronger, the better!

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: No, no, Paimonka, you got it all wrong. I like people who can protect others. That's why I like Furiosa, Zala, the Doctor, and the two of you too!

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: It's just that the stronger you are, the more people you can protect... I think that's why Furiosa said yes to growing branches!

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: ...They say she was the first person in town to grow branches. After the Doctor helped her grow them, she got new, stronger arms, and she became even better at fighting.

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: After that, everyone started spending most of their time at the assembly hall, while she stayed outside to keep us safe...

choices.text: But if I can't beat her, can I concede the match instead?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, hey, hey — why are you thinking of turning tail even before the match-up has happened??? Paimon totally believes in you!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: She's gone... We can enter the assembly hall now!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nastya? What is it? We're almost at your home, aren't we...?

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: I just don't understand... Why did Furiosa try to stop me... and why hasn't she turned into the Perfect Tree yet?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Why isn't anything happening? Is the switch broken because it hasn't been used in really long or something?

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Hmm, I think there's another switch on the other side. The curtain should open if we use both switches at the same time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Tell you what, Paimon's gonna fly over there, and you two stay here and activate this switch...

choices.text: You might not have enough strength to do that, Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Paimon's stronger than you think, okay! It's just a tiny switch... Mmgh... Ugh... The switch must be jammed!

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: #I'll give Paimonka a hand. The two of us together should be as good as one {M#Big Brother}{F#Big Sister} {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Can we do it...? Hold on... Let's do it together... One, two, three!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yes!!! We did it! Nastya and Paimon will stay on this side. You go over to the other side, and when Paimon gives the signal, we'll activate the mechanisms at the same time...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Aye, aye. Ready for your orders, Captain!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's see... We should be able to get through from over there.

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: #Be careful now, {M#Big Brother}{F#Big Sister} {NICKNAME}! That way looks dangerous! You haven't grown any branches yet, so it'll really hurt if you fall!

choices.text: Maybe I should go to the other side instead.

talks.objective: Find a way to get inside the assembly hall.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Alright, think that does it! Ooh, there's an elevator here. Let's meet up with {NICKNAME} downstairs.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hey, {NICKNAME}! We'll see you downstairs!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's not opening from this side... or from this side either...

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: #Paimonka, {M#Big Brother}{F#Big Sister} {NICKNAME}, we usually go through this door in the middle, but I think it's now locked from the inside...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Looks like we can get in through here.

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Hmm, I think... I can squeeze in through here? Wait for me. I'll go open the door.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay! Just call out to us if you run into any trouble, Nastya. Paimon can squeeze through to help too!

talks.objective: Wait for Nastya to open the door

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Phew... I'm just glad everyone's okay! I didn't know we were gonna find so many people here... behind the shelves.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Same... One second it was dead quiet, and the next, BOOM! They just came rushing out like that!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But hey, look at that new path that just opened up over here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It looks like the way home to me.

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: I don't know about that. But looks like it's the only path now, and the Doctor said before, "The only path is the right path."

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: So as long as I follow this path, I'm sure I'll make it back to mama and turn into the Perfect Tree...

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: The Doctor should be home too. He's never gonna leave. Zala is protecting him, so I know he's there.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Looks like we're close to finding the answer...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's keep going, then... Once we get to your "home" and meet Koshchei... no, Paimon means that "Doctor Moreau," we should finally get the answers we've been looking for.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow... This place is... spectacular...

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Yeah. It's so pretty, isn't it? ...But sometimes, I don't really like it here.

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: When we're here, we have to hold the little booklets Doctor Moreau wrote while we listen to him tell his stories... The grown-ups would all listen really carefully, so we aren't allowed to talk either.

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: But I don't always understand Doctor Moreau's stories. Sometimes, I'd secretly fall asleep, or just sit there thinking about nothing, or look at everything around me.

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: That's why I know this place pretty well... Huh? Why do some parts look different than before? Let me think...

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Oh, that's right! The curtain here, it's closed! We have to get behind it... I remember there's a path on the other side.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, look! That mechanism over there looks like it's connected to the curtain!

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Wow, you're really good at spotting stuff! That should be it. Let's go do it together! But it's so high up... I can't reach it...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You can wait for us here, Nastya.

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: ...No, no. I want to go with you. Family is supposed to stay together.

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Please let me come along... Don't worry, I'll stick real close, just like Paimonka...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um, okay. Hold on just a second while we think of something.

talks.objective: Find a way to move the curtain
Go to the other curtain switch

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Huh? Is {NICKNAME} already on the other side???

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Then Paimon must yell really, really loudly so that {M#he}{F#she} can hear Paimon clearly!

talks.objective: Activate both switches at the same time
Activate both switches at the same time

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Can we go up there and activate the switch together now?

choices.text: Let me think of a way first.

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: Okay... Good luck!

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: I remember this was carved to look like Zala. But Zala doesn't look like this anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: We have to keep going, through here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, okay! Onward we go~ Hang on, isn't this just a wall?

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: This is the doorway to home. Only the ones who are chosen can go through and become eternal life free of all worries.

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Doctor Moreau is the only one who's supposed to know how to open this door, but... But one time, I saw how he did it when I was hiding in a corner of the hall...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Nastya draws a simple diagram and hands it to you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, so this thing is actually a dial. To open the door behind it, we have to turn it to match the right pattern...

talks.objective: Head to the door leading to "home"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The dial isn't doing anything... Uh, is the mechanism here broken?

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: ...Oh! I remember now! For the last step, we gotta put the "salt" there.

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Doctor Moreau said that for a person to turn into the Perfect Tree, they have to change in three ways...

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: "Cast off the soul of the past, and it shall no longer be bound by the hidden veins of the earth." Then, the thing that replaces the soul of the past is... the um... s—sulfur of the soul?

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: "Cast off the will of the past, and it shall no longer be watched by the gaze above." And the thing that replaces the will is the silver of the spirit.

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: The last thing you have to cast off is... "Cast off the body of the past, and it shall no longer be worn away by the toil and turmoil of the mortal world." So at this point, we have to offer up the material that will replace the body.

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: So uh... The salt is... the new body that grows from the old one. Yes, that's it!

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Ow... This hurts a little more than I thought.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nastya... Are you okay?

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: I'm okay. It hurts a lot, but I'm happy. This way, I can go back home, and you can find the Doctor and ask him about Koshchei.

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: So this little bit of hurt doesn't matter... Hurry, hurry up and offer up the salt.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #...Uh, okay, sure. We'll do as you say. {NICKNAME}, let's put this little branch on that platform.

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Hmm... Once we go through the doorway, we're at home. But...

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: N-Nothing. I don't know why, but my heart feels a little messy, like a pile of fallen leaves...

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: The doctor once said that "the closer you get to home, the more nervous you feel.” I never understood it back then, but now I think I get it...

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: O-Okay. I trust you.

choices.text: Don’t worry. I'll open the doorway.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After finding a suitable spot, Nastya tosses over the items she just found to you...

talks.objective: Cover Nastya so she can get closer

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Oh yeah... the day the Volkodlak took us away, all of us kids were told to go to the assembly hall. My... My friends were probably here too...

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: It's been so long since I saw them.

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Uhh... Have you found anything?

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: Same here. Then we must hurry.

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: You're amazing! I haven't found anything yet. I need to try harder!

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: But where is Furiosa? I usually see her around here... I really wanna to see her!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Is Furiosa very important to you, Nastya?

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Of course! She's my idol! Or should I say, she's still my number-one idol right now, and you two are now at number two.

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: But that ranking's just for now. If you ever get a chance to spar someday, maybe that ranking will change!

choices.text: A chance to shake up the leaderboard has appeared!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #That's right, that's right! {NICKNAME} is a super good fighter, you know!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But Paimon gets it now: Nastya likes people who are good at fighting. The stronger, the better!

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: No, no, Paimonka, you got it all wrong. I like people who can protect others. That's why I like Furiosa, Anka, the Doctor, and the two of you too!

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: It's just that the stronger you are, the more people you can protect... I think that's why Furiosa said yes to growing branches!

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: ...They say she was the first person in town to grow branches. After the Doctor helped her grow them, all the problems she had went away... And she became even better at fighting.

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: After that, everyone started spending most of their time at the assembly hall, while she stayed outside to keep us safe...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So you want to keep more people safe too, Nastya? Is that why you want to grow leaves and branches too?

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: Um... I never really thought about it like that... I mean, I'm so small. Even if I got stronger, I still won't be that strong. All I want is to be just like everyone else in the family...

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: Hmm, if we do see Furiosa later, I wonder if she'll still know who I am...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, she definitely will! ...Hold on, what if she's like Anka!? What if she thinks we're Badbugs, stomps all over us, and burns us to a crisp!?

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: Mmm, don't worry about that. Furiosa will still spar with you even if you aren't Badbugs.

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: And burning Badbugs isn't her job... So even if she really thinks you two are Badbugs, you should be fine.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That'd better be the case!

choices.text: But if I can't beat her, can I concede the match instead?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, hey, hey — why are you thinking of turning tail even before the fight has happened??? Paimon totally believes in you!

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: #What is it, {M#Big Brother}{F#Big Sister} {NICKNAME}? Is something wrong?

choices.text: ...I'm a little worried about you and Paimon.

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: No need to worry. I'll protect Paimonka, and Paimonka will protect me.

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: A little tree will be blown over by the wind, but two little trees can lean on each other.

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: Okay. We'll be waiting for you.
